bullets.title: Would you do it if you could? Advanced DNA testing for embryos is here — and it’s fraught.
bullets.note:
[Click here](https://archive.ph/61uLA) if you have any issues accessing the link. From the article:  
​  
​_“This has somewhat flown under the societal radar, but it’s happening,” says Todd Lencz, a professor of psychiatry and molecular medicine in the Zucker School of Medicine at Hofstra/Northwell and a leading researcher on the new genetic testing of embryos. “It’s not a question of if it will happen, or what the technology will be in three years. People are doing this now.”_

bullets.section: Wholesome video I enjoyed a lot more than expected
bullets.title: Becorns Episode 3: Orioles vs Catbirds
bullets.note: This is both creatively inspiring and deeply calming. From the description: “A peek at my creative process as I create a Becorn and photograph it with an oriole... and inevitably, with catbirds too.” Thanks to Whitmire for sending me this family-friendly goodness, which makes a great palate cleanser after any craziness on the web.

bullets.section: Healthy and fast protein that I’m enjoying
bullets.title: Classic Norwegian Roasted Salmon from Changing Seas
bullets.note: These days, I’m doing endurance training in the morning for 3–4 hours, and I like quick turnaround meals. For protein, I’m alternating between these ready-to-eat salmon filets and [three sticks of Maui Nui wild-harvested venison](https://mauinuivenison.com/collections/best-sellers/products/sugar-free-pepper-stick-24-pack?variant=43384782160099).

bullets.title: “Health lies in action, and so it graces youth. To be busy is the secret of grace, and half the secret of content.
